description:
The 2027 BULLS Aminga is a full‑suspension eMTB built for riders who want confidence, comfort, and control on demanding terrain. With its Bosch BES3 Performance motor, 750Wh battery, and a 140/120mm suspension setup, the Aminga delivers smooth power and trail‑ready performance for long adventures.

Motor and Battery

Motor: Bosch Performance Line CX (BDU374Y), US version, delivering powerful 600% of maximum pedal‑assist support with responsive torque and smooth acceleration on climbs and technical sections.

Battery: Bosch PowerTube 750Wh (horizontal), fully integrated into the downtube for clean aesthetics and long‑range capability.

Display & Controls: Bosch LED Remote + Kiox 300 display for clear ride data, mode control, and system connectivity.

Suspension and Frame

Fork: SR Suntour Lytro‑34 Air Boost 2CR, 140mm travel, 15x110 Boost axle, matte‑black finish with custom decals.

Rear Shock: SR Suntour Edge X SV 2CR Trunnion, 180x55mm, tuned for traction and comfort with 120mm rear wheel travel.

Frame: BULLS alloy full‑suspension frame with Bosch 750 integration, hydroformed downtube, forged linkage, and internal cable routing.

Drivetrain and Brakes

Gearing: Shimano CUES 10‑speed drivetrain with RD‑U6000‑GS derailleur and 11–48T cassette for wide climbing range.

Crankset: Samox direct‑mount 38T chainring with narrow‑wide profile and Bosch Gen4 interface.

Brakes: Shimano MT200 hydraulic disc brakes with 203mm front rotor and 180mm rear rotor for reliable stopping power.

Wheels and Tires

Wheels: DDM‑12 27.5+ alloy rims (30mm internal width), Boost hubs, and stainless‑steel spokes for durability and stability.

Tires: Schwalbe Smart Sam 27.5 x 2.6" tires with KevlarGuard for versatile grip on mixed terrain.

Additional Features

Dropper Post: Limotec Z1 dropper post (100–150mm travel depending on frame size) with Shimano MT500 remote.

Saddle & Cockpit: Velo VL‑3644 saddle, Kalloy 760mm handlebar, and 50–70mm stem depending on size.

MonkeyLink Ready: Integrated MonkeyLink seat clamp and stem interfaces for quick‑mount lights and accessories.

Battery & Motor Protection: BULLS motor covers, battery cover, and integrated speed sensor system.

Key Takeaways

The 2027 BULLS Aminga is designed for riders who want a capable, comfortable, and confidence‑inspiring eMTB with premium Bosch power, long‑range capability, and a trail‑ready suspension platform.
